nodes.label: Five-Stage Pipeline (Fetch, Clean, Store, Analyze, Render)
nodes.rationale: Stages are deliberately independent so a fetch failure does not block analysis of previously stored data; the dashboard reads from the DB so it can be regenerated without re-fetching. main.py orchestrates fetch-clean-store; scripts/generate_html.py orchestrates analyze-render.

nodes.label: Native Units, Convert at Display Rule
nodes.rationale: DB stores native exchange units (cents/bu, cents/lb, $/short ton); conversion to USD/MT happens only at display via pipeline/units. Round-tripping through MT introduces rounding error and makes the source of truth for downstream math ambiguous; a fixed storage unit gives every analysis function and test one obvious input space.

nodes.label: One-Way Module Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: Dependency direction is strictly one-way: fetchers never import pipeline or analysis; pipeline never imports analysis; analysis imports only pipeline/query and pipeline/units. Keeps layers independently evolvable and testable.

nodes.label: Turso-or-SQLite Storage Abstraction
nodes.rationale: pipeline/connection.py returns a Turso cloud connection when TURSO_DATABASE_URL is set, local SQLite otherwise; call sites don't care which. MIRROR_REQUIRE_TURSO=1 opts into strict mode so CI/production deploys don't silently fall back to local SQLite and mask a config bug.
